yfinance.description: Primary MCP server for 10-year Indian equities historical OHLCV, financial statements, and company news (yfinance-mcp-server via uvx / fastmcp).

nse.description: National Stock Exchange of India official MCP server (https://mcp.nseindia.in/cmmkt/mcp) for near real-time live cash-market quotes and indices.

alphavantage.description: Alpha Vantage MCP server (evaluated; restricted to BSE symbols, 100-day limit on free tier, requires ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY).

reddit.description: Reddit MCP server for retail trading community sentiment (r/IndianStockMarket, r/IndiaInvestments, requires OAuth API credentials).
